description:
Net present value of cashflows on actual calendar dates (irregular spacing allowed).

Actual/365 day count (matches Excel XNPV); base date is the earliest cashflow.

cashflows.description: Dated cashflows; discounted by actual days from the earliest date.

items.description: A single cashflow on a calendar date (for XNPV/XIRR).

amount.description: Cashflow amount; outflows negative, inflows positive.

rate.description: Annual discount rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.08 for 8%.

name: xnpv

outputSchema.description: Net present value at a given discount rate.

rate.description: Discount rate used, as a decimal: per period for npv, annual for xnpv.

title: Net Present Value (Dated Cashflows)
